en.title: FAR 25.1101(b)(1)(iv) refers to 25.102(d); section 25.102 has no paragraph (d)
en.summary: FAR 25.1101(b)(1)(iv) applies when the senior procurement executive allows an alternate domestic content test “in accordance with 25.102(d)”. Section 25.102 is a single unnumbered paragraph. The authority for the alternate domestic content test is in 25.101(d). The FAR Overhaul Part 25 text keeps the same reference at 25.601(b)(1)(iv).
en.impact: No affected contract has been established.
en.correction: Refer to 25.101(d) in 25.1101(b)(1)(iv) and in the Overhaul 25.601(b)(1)(iv).
